backend/main.mo: Motoko actor storing golf events, calculating Callaway results, and sorting golfers using a static chart.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to involved files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of many frontend files for reference or documentation.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base/theme variables defining color tokens and styles for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app handling navigation, event setup, score entry, Callaway calculation, and admin/settings access.
frontend/src/features/admin/AdminView.ts: Admin screen that checks access status and renders the Callaway chart editor or an access‑denied message.
frontend/src/features/admin/CallawayChar: UI to edit, validate, and save custom Callaway scoring charts for 9 or 18 holes.
frontend/src/features/eventSetup/EventSe: Form for configuring event title, golfer count, hole count, and course par before scoring.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Breakd: Displays a detailed Callaway scoring breakdown for a single player.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Callaw: Shows the Callaway scoring chart for the selected hole count with explanatory notes.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Leader: Renders ranked leaderboard rows with net, gross, deduction, and adjustment values.
Composes the full leaderboard page with standings, chart, and detailed player breakdowns.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/GolferS: Inputs for entering golfer names and per-hole scores, updating parent state on change.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/validat: Validates golfer score entries for required fields, hole counts, and score ranges.
frontend/src/features/settings/SettingsV: React settings page that toggles admin access and includes a back button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, handling login, logout, and stored identity loading.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hook that retrieves the latest result from the backend actor if available.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining light/dark themes with a golf-themed color palette.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callaway.ts: Implements Callaway handicap calculation using gross scores, worst-hole deductions, and chart adjustments.
Defines default 9- and 18-hole Callaway charts and includes logic to find the correct entry for a gross score.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callawayChartP: Handles loading, validating, saving, and resetting edited Callaway charts with localStorage fallback to defaults.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point that initializes React, React Query, and the Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/state/adminAccess.ts: Manages admin access state using localStorage getters and setters.
frontend/src/state/eventTypes.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for event setup, golfer data, and Callaway result data.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS config extending theme colors, fonts, animations, and enabling typography, container queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Defines project state and features for a Callaway scoring app, including settings toggle, admin screen, and chart editor requirements.
